questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A projectile is thrown with speed u at an angle θ to the horizontal. Its total time of flight is:
questions.explanation: The time to rise is u sin θ / g, and the fall takes exactly as long, so the whole flight lasts twice that. The last option is the range, not a time.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The first law of thermodynamics, ΔQ = ΔU + ΔW, is essentially a statement of the:
questions.explanation: Heat supplied to a system either raises its internal energy or is spent doing work, so no energy is created or destroyed. The second law deals with entropy and direction.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Kirchhoff's junction rule, that the sum of currents entering a junction equals the sum leaving it, follows from the conservation of:
questions.explanation: Charge cannot pile up at a junction in a steady current, so whatever flows in must flow out. The loop rule is the one based on conservation of energy.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Carbon combines with oxygen to form CO and CO₂, in which the masses of oxygen combining with a fixed mass of carbon are in the simple ratio 1 : 2. This illustrates the law of:
questions.explanation: Dalton's law of multiple proportions applies when two elements form more than one compound, and the masses of one element combining with a fixed mass of the other bear a simple whole number ratio.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The hybridisation of phosphorus in the PCl₅ molecule, which has a trigonal bipyramidal shape, is:
questions.explanation: Five bond pairs need five hybrid orbitals, so one 3s, three 3p and one 3d orbital mix. The two axial bonds are longer and weaker than the three equatorial ones.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 4: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Oxidation of a secondary alcohol with acidified potassium dichromate gives:
questions.explanation: A secondary alcohol has one hydrogen on the carbinol carbon, so oxidation stops at the ketone. A primary alcohol goes on to the acid, and a tertiary one resists oxidation.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 7: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Viruses are regarded as being on the borderline between living and non-living mainly because they:
options: Have a cell wall but no nucleus
Can reproduce only inside a living host cell and are inert outside it
questions.explanation: A virus is a nucleoprotein with no metabolism of its own, yet it has genetic material and can mutate, so it shows living properties only inside a host.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Mendel's law of segregation is based on the fact that the two alleles of a gene:
options: Separate without being contaminated, so each gamete gets only one
Always stay together in the gamete
Are both lost during gamete formation
questions.explanation: This is why it is also called the law of purity of gametes, and why a recessive trait hidden in F₁ reappears unchanged in F₂.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 4: Principles of Inheritance and Variation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: In a simple reflex arc such as the knee jerk, the impulse travels from the receptor to the effector through the:
options: Spinal cord, without first reaching the brain
questions.explanation: A reflex action is involuntary and quick because the spinal cord itself links the afferent and efferent neurons; the brain learns of it only afterwards.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which of the following is a primary lymphoid organ where lymphocytes mature into immunocompetent cells?
questions.explanation: Bone marrow and thymus are primary organs where lymphocytes are formed and differentiated. Spleen, lymph nodes and tonsils are secondary organs where they meet antigens.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
